title: Herbal Ukrainian Potato Curry
description: A fragrant, plantbased curry that marries Ukrainian comfort food with Thai red curry heat, simmered in a pressure cooker for tender potatoes and herbs.
instructions: Prepare ingredients: peel and cube potatoes, slice onion and carrot, chop dill and parsley, zest lemon.
Heat the pressure cooker on medium, sauté the onion and carrot in a splash of oil until translucent, about 3‑4 minutes.
Add the Thai red curry paste and stir to coat the vegetables, cooking for 1 minute to release aromas.
Pour in the vegetable broth and coconut milk, then add the cubed potatoes; stir to combine.
Seal the pressure cooker, set to high pressure and cook for 8 minutes.
Quick‑release the pressure, then carefully open the lid.
Stir in the chopped dill, parsley, lemon zest, and season with salt to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with extra fresh herbs if desired.
